package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TaskHandler handles task endpoints.
type TaskHandler struct {
	Validator                     *validator.Validate
	CreateUC                      task.CreateTask
	UpdateUC                      task.UpdateTask
	UploadStarterArchiveUC        task.UploadStarterArchive
	DeleteUC                      task.DeleteTask
	GetUC                         task.GetTask
	GetDetailsUC                  task.GetTaskDetails
	ListUC                        task.ListTasksByLesson
	GetInternalCourseStructureUC  task.GetInternalCourseStructure
	GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC task.GetInternalCompletedLessons
	Access                        contentaccess.Service
}

type taskTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type taskLearningTargetRequest struct {
	Type    string `json:"type" validate:"required,oneof=concept capability"`
	Key     string `json:"key" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Version string `json:"version" validate:"omitempty,max=128"`
}

type taskTestTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type taskTestVariantTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Text   string `json:"text" validate:"required,max=1024"`
}

type taskTestGroupTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title  string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
}

type taskTestGroupRequest struct {
	ID           string                            `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey    string                            `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Order        int                               `json:"order" validate:"min=1"`
	Translations []taskTestGroupTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
}

type taskTestVariantRequest struct {
	ID             string                              `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey      string                              `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Order          int                                 `json:"order" validate:"min=1"`
	IsCorrect      bool                                `json:"is_correct"`
	CorrectOrder   *int                                `json:"correct_order" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	GroupID        string                              `json:"group_id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	GroupSourceKey string                              `json:"group_source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Translations   []taskTestVariantTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
}

type taskTestRequest struct {
	ID           string                       `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey    string                       `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Kind         string                       `json:"kind" validate:"omitempty,oneof=single_choice ordering classification"`
	Order        int                          `json:"order" validate:"min=1"`
	Translations []taskTestTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
	Groups       []taskTestGroupRequest       `json:"groups" validate:"omitempty,max=20,dive"`
	Variants     []taskTestVariantRequest     `json:"variants" validate:"required,min=2,max=50,dive"`
}

type optionalRawMessage struct {
	Value json.RawMessage
	Set   bool
}

func (value *optionalRawMessage) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	value.Set = true
	if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(data), []byte("null")) {
		value.Value = nil
		return nil
	}
	value.Value = append(value.Value[:0], data...)
	return nil
}

// CreateTaskRequest body.
type CreateTaskRequest struct {
	ID                     string                      `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey              string                      `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Title                  string                      `json:"title" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Description            string                      `json:"description"`
	Translations           []taskTranslationRequest    `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
	LearningTargets        []taskLearningTargetRequest `json:"learning_targets" validate:"omitempty,max=100,dive"`
	CodeStructureTypeID    string                      `json:"code_structure_type_id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage             `json:"code_structure"`
	ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage             `json:"compose_config"`
	Type                   *string                     `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose      *string                     `json:"assessment_purpose" validate:"omitempty,oneof=knowledge_check diagnostic"`
	TaskKind               *string                     `json:"task_kind"`
	ExecutionMode          *string                     `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         *string                     `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 *string                     `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         *string                     `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        *bool                       `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         *bool                       `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        *bool                       `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation *bool                       `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	AllowedErrorsCount     int                         `json:"allowed_errors_count" validate:"min=0"`
	Tests                  []taskTestRequest           `json:"tests" validate:"omitempty,min=1,dive"`
	Order                  int                         `json:"order" validate:"min=0"`
	MaxAttempts            *int                        `json:"max_attempts" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	LessonID               string                      `json:"lesson_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
}

// UpdateTaskRequest body.
type UpdateTaskRequest struct {
	Title                  string                       `json:"title" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Description            string                       `json:"description"`
	Translations           []taskTranslationRequest     `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=1,dive"`
	LearningTargets        *[]taskLearningTargetRequest `json:"learning_targets" validate:"omitempty,max=100,dive"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage              `json:"code_structure"`
	ComposeConfig          optionalRawMessage           `json:"compose_config"`
	Type                   *string                      `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose      *string                      `json:"assessment_purpose" validate:"omitempty,oneof=knowledge_check diagnostic"`
	TaskKind               *string                      `json:"task_kind"`
	ExecutionMode          *string                      `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         *string                      `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 *string                      `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         *string                      `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        *bool                        `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         *bool                        `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        *bool                        `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation *bool                        `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	AllowedErrorsCount     *int                         `json:"allowed_errors_count" validate:"omitempty,min=0"`
	Tests                  []taskTestRequest            `json:"tests" validate:"omitempty,min=1,dive"`
	Order                  int                          `json:"order" validate:"min=0"`
	MaxAttempts            *int                         `json:"max_attempts" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Status                 int                          `json:"status" validate:"required,oneof=0 1"`
}

// Create handles creation.
func (h TaskHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req CreateTaskRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	task, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), task.CreateTaskInput{
		ID:                     req.ID,
		SourceKey:              req.SourceKey,
		LessonID:               req.LessonID,
		Title:                  req.Title,
		Description:            req.Description,
		Translations:           mapTaskTranslations(req.Translations),
		LearningTargets:        mapTaskLearningTargets(req.LearningTargets),
		CodeStructureTypeID:    req.CodeStructureTypeID,
		CodeStructure:          req.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          req.ComposeConfig,
		Type:                   firstNonEmptyString(req.Type, req.TaskKind),
		AssessmentPurpose:      req.AssessmentPurpose,
		ExecutionMode:          req.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         req.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 req.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         req.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        req.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         req.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        req.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: req.SupportsLiveValidation,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     req.AllowedErrorsCount,
		Tests:                  mapTaskTests(req.Tests),
		Order:                  req.Order,
		MaxAttempts:            req.MaxAttempts,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(buildTaskResponse(&task, nil, nil, false, false, nil))
}

// Update handles task update.
func (h TaskHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	var req UpdateTaskRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	var composeConfig *[]byte
	if req.ComposeConfig.Set {
		cfg := []byte(req.ComposeConfig.Value)
		composeConfig = &cfg
	}
	var learningTargets *[]domain.TaskLearningTarget
	if req.LearningTargets != nil {
		mapped := mapTaskLearningTargets(*req.LearningTargets)
		learningTargets = &mapped
	}
	updated, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), task.UpdateTaskInput{
		ID:                     taskID,
		Title:                  req.Title,
		Description:            req.Description,
		Translations:           mapTaskTranslations(req.Translations),
		LearningTargets:        learningTargets,
		CodeStructure:          req.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          composeConfig,
		Type:                   firstNonEmptyString(req.Type, req.TaskKind),
		AssessmentPurpose:      req.AssessmentPurpose,
		ExecutionMode:          req.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         req.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 req.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         req.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        req.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         req.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        req.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: req.SupportsLiveValidation,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     req.AllowedErrorsCount,
		Tests:                  mapTaskTests(req.Tests),
		Order:                  req.Order,
		MaxAttempts:            req.MaxAttempts,
		Status:                 req.Status,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(buildTaskResponse(updated, nil, nil, false, false, nil))
}

func (h TaskHandler) UploadStarterFiles(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	if taskID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "taskID is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	files, err := collectStarterUploadFiles(r)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	archiveData, archiveFilename, err := buildStarterArchive(files)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.UploadStarterArchiveUC.Handle(r.Context(), task.UploadStarterArchiveInput{
		TaskID:           taskID,
		OriginalFilename: archiveFilename,
		ArchiveData:      archiveData,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"starter_files": mapTaskStarterFileResponse(result.StarterFiles),
	})
}

// List returns tasks for lesson.
func (h TaskHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// Parse and validate fields
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.TaskAllowedFields)

	// Parse filters and sort from query parameters
	filters, err := parsers.ParseTaskFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	sort := parsers.ParseSortOptions(r)

	if lessonID != "" {
		if filters.LessonID != nil && *filters.LessonID != lessonID {
			http.Error(w, "lesson_id does not match path", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		filters.LessonID = &lessonID
	} else if filters.LessonID != nil {
		lessonID = *filters.LessonID
	}

	// If lessonID is still empty, return error
	if lessonID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "lessonID is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if !isPrivilegedRequest(r) {
		if err := h.Access.RequireLesson(r.Context(), lessonID, r.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam)); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
		active := domain.TaskStatusActive
		filters.Status = &active
	}

	tasks, total, err := h.ListUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), lessonID, f, filters, sort)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	// Ensure we return empty array instead of null
	if tasks == nil {
		tasks = []map[string]any{}
	}
	for _, item := range tasks {
		augmentTaskMap(item)
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"tasks": tasks,
		"meta":  buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// Get returns task details for public consumption.
func (h TaskHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	if !isPrivilegedRequest(r) {
		if err := h.Access.RequireTask(r.Context(), taskID, r.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam)); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")

	// If fields parameter is provided, use dynamic field selection
	if fieldsParam != "" {
		f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.TaskAllowedFields)
		result, err := h.GetUC.HandleWithFields(r.Context(), taskID, f)
		if err != nil {
			if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
				http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
				return
			}
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		augmentTaskMap(result)
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
		return
	}

	h.renderTask(w, r, false, false)
}

// GetAdmin returns task details for admin screens, including test correctness flags.
func (h TaskHandler) GetAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.renderTask(w, r, false, true)
}

// GetInternalTask returns task metadata for internal consumers.
func (h TaskHandler) GetInternalTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.renderTask(w, r, true, true)
}

// GetInternalCourseStructure returns ordered lessons/tasks for one course.
func (h TaskHandler) GetInternalCourseStructure(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	if courseID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "courseID is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if h.GetInternalCourseStructureUC.Lessons == nil || h.GetInternalCourseStructureUC.Tasks == nil {
		http.Error(w, "internal dependencies are not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	response, err := h.GetInternalCourseStructureUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)
}

// GetInternalCompletedLessons returns completed lesson ids for one student and selected lesson ids.
func (h TaskHandler) GetInternalCompletedLessons(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("user_id"))
	if userID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "user_id is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	lessonIDs := splitCSVQuery(r.URL.Query().Get("lesson_ids"))
	if len(lessonIDs) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "lesson_ids is required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if h.GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC.Lessons == nil || h.GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC.Tasks == nil || h.GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(w, "internal dependencies are not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	response, err := h.GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC.Handle(r.Context(), userID, lessonIDs)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrForbidden {
			http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response)
}

func (h TaskHandler) renderTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, includeInternal bool, includeCorrectAnswers bool) {
	if h.GetDetailsUC.Tasks == nil {
		http.Error(w, "task details are not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	details, err := h.GetDetailsUC.Handle(r.Context(), taskID, includeInternal)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	resp := buildTaskResponse(details.Task, details.Tests, details.StarterFiles, includeInternal, includeCorrectAnswers, details.CodeStructureTypeCode)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

// Delete handles DELETE /admin/tasks/{taskID}.
func (h TaskHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), task.DeleteTaskInput{TaskID: taskID}); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

type taskResponse struct {
	ID                     string                       `json:"id"`
	LessonID               string                       `json:"lesson_id"`
	Title                  string                       `json:"title"`
	Description            string                       `json:"description"`
	Translations           []taskTranslationResponse    `json:"translations,omitempty"`
	LearningTargets        []taskLearningTargetResponse `json:"learning_targets,omitempty"`
	CodeStructureTypeID    string                       `json:"code_structure_type_id"`
	CodeStructureType      *string                      `json:"code_structure_type_code,omitempty"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage              `json:"code_structure"`
	ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage              `json:"compose_config"`
	Type                   int16                        `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose      string                       `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	TaskKind               string                       `json:"task_kind"`
	ExecutionMode          string                       `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string                       `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string                       `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string                       `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool                         `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool                         `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool                         `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool                         `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	AllowedErrorsCount     int                          `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
	Order                  int                          `json:"order"`
	Status                 int                          `json:"status"`
	Version                int                          `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time                    `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time                    `json:"updated_at"`
	MaxAttempts            *int                         `json:"max_attempts,omitempty"`
	DeadlineAt             *time.Time                   `json:"deadline_at,omitempty"`
	Tests                  []taskTestResponse           `json:"tests,omitempty"`
	StarterFiles           []taskStarterFileResponse    `json:"starter_files,omitempty"`
}

type taskTranslationResponse struct {
	TaskID      string `json:"task_id"`
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Lang        string `json:"lang,omitempty"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type taskTestResponse struct {
	ID           string                        `json:"id"`
	SourceKey    string                        `json:"source_key,omitempty"`
	TaskID       string                        `json:"task_id"`
	Kind         string                        `json:"kind"`
	Title        string                        `json:"title"`
	Description  string                        `json:"description"`
	Translations []taskTestTranslationResponse `json:"translations,omitempty"`
	Order        int                           `json:"order"`
	Groups       []taskTestGroupResponse       `json:"groups,omitempty"`
	Variants     []taskTestVariantResponse     `json:"variants,omitempty"`
}

type taskTestGroupResponse struct {
	ID           string                             `json:"id"`
	SourceKey    string                             `json:"source_key,omitempty"`
	TaskTestID   string                             `json:"task_test_id"`
	Title        string                             `json:"title"`
	Translations []taskTestGroupTranslationResponse `json:"translations,omitempty"`
	Order        int                                `json:"order"`
}

type taskTestGroupTranslationResponse struct {
	TaskTestGroupID string `json:"task_test_group_id"`
	I18nID          int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Lang            string `json:"lang,omitempty"`
	Title           string `json:"title"`
}

type taskTestTranslationResponse struct {
	TaskTestID  string `json:"task_test_id"`
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Lang        string `json:"lang,omitempty"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

type taskTestVariantResponse struct {
	ID             string                               `json:"id"`
	SourceKey      string                               `json:"source_key,omitempty"`
	TaskTestID     string                               `json:"task_test_id"`
	Text           string                               `json:"text"`
	IsCorrect      *bool                                `json:"is_correct,omitempty"`
	CorrectOrder   *int                                 `json:"correct_order,omitempty"`
	GroupID        *string                              `json:"group_id,omitempty"`
	GroupSourceKey *string                              `json:"group_source_key,omitempty"`
	Translations   []taskTestVariantTranslationResponse `json:"translations,omitempty"`
	Order          int                                  `json:"order"`
}

type taskTestVariantTranslationResponse struct {
	TaskTestVariantID string `json:"task_test_variant_id"`
	I18nID            int    `json:"i18n_id"`
	Lang              string `json:"lang,omitempty"`
	Text              string `json:"text"`
}

type taskStarterFileResponse struct {
	Type          int16  `json:"type"`
	FileStorageID string `json:"filestorage_id"`
	Order         int    `json:"order"`
}

type taskLearningTargetResponse struct {
	Type    domain.LearningTargetType `json:"type"`
	Key     string                    `json:"key"`
	Version string                    `json:"version,omitempty"`
}

func buildTaskResponse(t *domain.Task, tests []domain.TaskTest, starterFiles []domain.TaskFileStorage, includeInternal bool, includeCorrectAnswers bool, codeStructureTypeCode *string) taskResponse {
	compose := t.ResolvedComposeConfig
	if compose == nil {
		compose = t.ComposeConfig
	}
	resp := taskResponse{
		ID:                     t.ID,
		LessonID:               t.LessonID,
		Title:                  t.Title,
		Description:            t.Description,
		Translations:           mapTaskTranslationResponse(t.Translations),
		LearningTargets:        mapTaskLearningTargetResponse(t.LearningTargets),
		CodeStructureTypeID:    t.CodeStructureTypeID,
		CodeStructure:          t.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          compose,
		Type:                   t.Type,
		AssessmentPurpose:      domain.AssessmentPurposeValue(t.AssessmentPurpose),
		TaskKind:               domain.TaskTypeName(t.Type),
		ExecutionMode:          domain.TaskExecutionModeName(t.ExecutionMode),
		EvaluationMode:         domain.TaskEvaluationModeName(t.EvaluationMode),
		UIMode:                 domain.TaskUIModeName(t.UIMode),
		SubmissionMode:         domain.TaskSubmissionModeName(t.SubmissionMode),
		RequiresSandbox:        t.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         t.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        t.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: t.SupportsLiveValidation,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     t.AllowedErrorsCount,
		Order:                  t.Order,
		Status:                 t.Status,
		Version:                t.Version,
		CreatedAt:              t.CreatedAt,
		UpdatedAt:              t.UpdatedAt,
		MaxAttempts:            t.MaxAttempts,
		DeadlineAt:             t.DeadlineAt,
		Tests:                  mapTaskTestResponse(tests, includeCorrectAnswers),
		StarterFiles:           mapTaskStarterFileResponse(starterFiles),
	}
	if includeInternal {
		resp.CodeStructureType = codeStructureTypeCode
	}
	return resp
}

func splitCSVQuery(raw string) []string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	result := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(part)
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result
}

	if len(items) == 0 {

			Type:          item.Type,
			FileStorageID: item.FileStorageID,
			Order:         item.Order,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTests(tests []taskTestRequest) []domain.TaskTest {
	result := make([]domain.TaskTest, 0, len(tests))
	for _, test := range tests {
		result = append(result, domain.TaskTest{
			ID:           test.ID,
			SourceKey:    test.SourceKey,
			Kind:         test.Kind,
			Order:        test.Order,
			Translations: mapTaskTestTranslations(test.Translations),
			Groups:       mapTaskTestGroups(test.Groups),
			Variants:     mapTaskTestVariants(test.Variants),
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestGroups(groups []taskTestGroupRequest) []domain.TaskTestGroup {
	result := make([]domain.TaskTestGroup, 0, len(groups))
	for _, group := range groups {
		translations := make([]domain.TaskTestGroupI18n, 0, len(group.Translations))
		for _, translation := range group.Translations {
			translations = append(translations, domain.TaskTestGroupI18n{
				I18nID: translation.I18nID,
				Title:  translation.Title,
			})
		}
		result = append(result, domain.TaskTestGroup{
			ID:           group.ID,
			SourceKey:    group.SourceKey,
			Order:        group.Order,
			Translations: translations,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTranslationResponse(translations []domain.TaskI18n) []taskTranslationResponse {
	if len(translations) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	result := make([]taskTranslationResponse, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, taskTranslationResponse{
			TaskID:      translation.TaskID,
			I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
			Lang:        translation.Language,
			Title:       translation.Title,
			Description: translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestResponse(tests []domain.TaskTest, includeCorrectAnswers bool) []taskTestResponse {
	if len(tests) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]taskTestResponse, 0, len(tests))
	for _, test := range tests {
		result = append(result, taskTestResponse{
			ID:           test.ID,
			SourceKey:    test.SourceKey,
			TaskID:       test.TaskID,
			Kind:         test.Kind,
			Title:        test.Title,
			Description:  test.Description,
			Translations: mapTaskTestTranslationResponse(test.Translations),
			Order:        test.Order,
			Groups:       mapTaskTestGroupResponse(test.Groups),
			Variants:     mapTaskTestVariantResponse(test.Variants, includeCorrectAnswers),
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestGroupResponse(groups []domain.TaskTestGroup) []taskTestGroupResponse {
	if len(groups) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]taskTestGroupResponse, 0, len(groups))
	for _, group := range groups {
		translations := make([]taskTestGroupTranslationResponse, 0, len(group.Translations))
		for _, translation := range group.Translations {
			translations = append(translations, taskTestGroupTranslationResponse{
				TaskTestGroupID: translation.TaskTestGroupID,
				I18nID:          translation.I18nID,
				Lang:            translation.Language,
				Title:           translation.Title,
			})
		}
		result = append(result, taskTestGroupResponse{
			ID:           group.ID,
			SourceKey:    group.SourceKey,
			TaskTestID:   group.TaskTestID,
			Title:        group.Title,
			Translations: translations,
			Order:        group.Order,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestTranslationResponse(translations []domain.TaskTestI18n) []taskTestTranslationResponse {
	if len(translations) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]taskTestTranslationResponse, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, taskTestTranslationResponse{
			TaskTestID:  translation.TaskTestID,
			I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
			Lang:        translation.Language,
			Title:       translation.Title,
			Description: translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestVariantResponse(variants []domain.TaskTestVariant, includeCorrectAnswers bool) []taskTestVariantResponse {
	if len(variants) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]taskTestVariantResponse, 0, len(variants))
	for _, variant := range variants {
		item := taskTestVariantResponse{
			ID:           variant.ID,
			SourceKey:    variant.SourceKey,
			TaskTestID:   variant.TaskTestID,
			Text:         variant.Text,
			Translations: mapTaskTestVariantTranslationResponse(variant.Translations),
			Order:        variant.Order,
		}
		if includeCorrectAnswers {
			isCorrect := variant.IsCorrect
			item.IsCorrect = &isCorrect
			item.CorrectOrder = variant.CorrectOrder
			if variant.GroupID != "" {
				groupID := variant.GroupID
				item.GroupID = &groupID
			}
			if variant.GroupSourceKey != "" {
				groupSourceKey := variant.GroupSourceKey
				item.GroupSourceKey = &groupSourceKey
			}
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result
}

func mapTaskTestVariantTranslationResponse(translations []domain.TaskTestVariantI18n) []taskTestVariantTranslationResponse {
	if len(translations) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]taskTestVariantTranslationResponse, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, taskTestVariantTranslationResponse{
			TaskTestVariantID: translation.TaskTestVariantID,
			I18nID:            translation.I18nID,
			Lang:              translation.Language,
			Text:              translation.Text,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func firstNonEmptyString(primary, fallback *string) *string {
	if primary != nil && *primary != "" {
		return primary
	}
	if fallback != nil {
		return fallback
	}
	return primary
}

func augmentTaskMap(item map[string]any) {
	if item == nil {
		return
	}

	if raw, ok := item["type"]; ok {
		if code, ok := toTaskEnumCode(raw); ok {
			item["type"] = code
			item["task_kind"] = domain.TaskTypeName(code)
		}
	}

	if raw, ok := item["task_kind"]; ok {
		switch v := raw.(type) {
		case string:
			item["task_kind"] = v
			if _, exists := item["type"]; !exists {
				if code, err := domain.ParseTaskType(v); err == nil {
					item["type"] = code
				}
			}
		default:
			if code, ok := toTaskEnumCode(v); ok {
				item["type"] = code
				item["task_kind"] = domain.TaskTypeName(code)
			}
		}
	}

	normalizeTaskEnumLabel(item, "execution_mode", domain.TaskExecutionModeName)
	normalizeTaskEnumLabel(item, "evaluation_mode", domain.TaskEvaluationModeName)
	normalizeTaskEnumLabel(item, "ui_mode", domain.TaskUIModeName)
	normalizeTaskEnumLabel(item, "submission_mode", domain.TaskSubmissionModeName)
}

func normalizeTaskEnumLabel(item map[string]any, key string, toName func(int16) string) {
	raw, ok := item[key]
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	if label, ok := raw.(string); ok && label != "" {
		return
	}
	if code, ok := toTaskEnumCode(raw); ok {
		item[key] = toName(code)
	}
}

func toTaskEnumCode(value any) (int16, bool) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case string:
		return 0, false
	case int:
		return int16(v), true
	case int16:
		return v, true
	case int8:
		return int16(v), true
	case int32:
		return int16(v), true
	case int64:
		return int16(v), true
	case float64:
		return int16(v), true
	case float32:
		return int16(v), true
	case uint:
		return int16(v), true
	case uint8:
		return int16(v), true
	case uint16:
		return int16(v), true
	case uint32:
		return int16(v), true
	case uint64:
		return int16(v), true
	}
	return 0, false
}
